create_pipeline_instance: create an OpenAI DALL-E manifold pipeline instance with custom API key and image settings
list_dalle_models: list all available DALL-E image generation models from the OpenAI API
generate_image_from_prompt: generate DALL-E images from a text prompt using the pipeline pipe method
configure_pipeline_valves: configure pipeline valves for OpenAI base URL, API key, image size, and number of images
handle_pipeline_lifecycle: handle pipeline startup, shutdown, and valves update lifecycle events
